text:
Elaine: Quick UX check — noticed in the console toolbar when the settings modal opens the primary CTA looks visually shifted because the toast pushes the header down. Screenshot attached: https://placeholder.img/console-toast-shift.png
Sam: I can repro on mac Chrome. Toast is currently in the normal flow, so the header is getting a layout shift.
Maria: that shift also causes keyboard focus to jump a bit for users tabbing into the modal. low confidence for a11y.
Elaine: Proposed fixes: 1) make toast overlay (position fixed) so it doesn’t reflow the page, 2) review button spacing token used in the toolbar (seems we’re on --space-2, feels tight when toast appears), 3) strengthen focus ring on icon-only buttons.
Ryan: agree on fixed toasts. quick CSS idea: 
```css
.redwood-toast { position: fixed; top: 12px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 9500; animation: slideDown .18s; }
.redwood-modal { z-index: 9600; }
```
Sam: small nit — using fixed can cause toasts to overlap modals on very small screens where modal is full-screen. we should ensure modal z-index > toast and also avoid pointer-blocking.
Jordan: for mobile we can lower toast height and auto-hide quicker. but agree modal must always be topmost for accessibility.
Maria: accessibility: current focus ring on icon buttons is a 1px dim outline. WCAG suggests stronger contrast. Suggest using --focus-ring-2 (2px) with color token --color-interactive-focus. Also add distinct aria-labels for icon-only controls (e.g., aria-label="Open settings").
Elaine: good call. I noticed some toolbar icons are missing aria-labels — that likely explains why screen reader users can’t find settings easily.
Sam: plus copy tweak: primary button text in modal is "Save" vs elsewhere it's "Save changes" — inconsistent microcopy. which do we prefer?
Maria: prefer "Save changes" in modals for clarity. I’ll search/replace in design tokens where appropriate.
Ryan: animation suggestion: use transform for toast entrance to avoid triggering layout and paints (translateY + opacity). Sam: yes, transform + will-change for perf.
Jordan: should we update spacing token --space-2 -> --space-2a (8px -> 10px) or just bump usages in toolbar? changing token globally might affect other surfaces.
Elaine: prefer scoped change first: update toolbar component to use --space-2a (new token) then decide if token should be promoted globally. create migration note either way.
Maria: I’ll create a PR with: toolbar spacing bump, focus-ring update, aria-labels for icon buttons, copy unify. will include screenshots and keyboard nav test.
Design-bot: PR opened: redwood/design-system#423 — "toolbar: spacing, focus, toasts stacking" (assigned to Maria)
Elaine: thank you! can someone confirm the regression test we want? keyboard nav should keep focus stable when toast appears; also visually verify no header jump.
Sam: I’ll add an e2e that triggers a toast while tabbing into modal and asserts no document.activeElement change and no layout shift > 5px.
Maria: rough checklist for PR: 1) toolbar snapshot, 2) keyboard nav e2e, 3) mobile toast behaviour notes, 4) copy updates.
Ryan: If we change z-indexes, add a short comment in the tokens file explaining ordering conventions so future folks don't pick arbitrary numbers.
Elaine: Sounds good. tagging @platform-ux for visibility. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam: :+1:
Maria: working on it now — will link PR for review in ~30m.
Design-bot: PR linked to issue #874 (console visual regressions).
